args.title: Fix export file name date to use local date instead of UTC
args.body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

Change formatExportFilename to use the local date instead of the UTC date when formatting the export file name so that exports done in the evening in the user's timezone use the correct date.

label: bug
file: src/exportUtils.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The export file name is generated by formatExportFilename in src/exportUtils.ts, which uses the current date in UTC. This causes evening exports in some timezones to show the next day's date. The fix is to use the local date instead for the timestamp part of the file name.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Amounts are stored as bigint in the database in minor currency units (such as cents), which are handled as JavaScript numbers. This avoids rounding errors that can occur with floating point. For currencies without minor units like yen, amounts are stored as integers without decimal parts. This ensures amounts are kept exactly with no rounding introduced by storage.

args.title: Fix report name duplication truncation to append (copy) correctly
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

When duplicating a report with a name close to the 120-character limit, the truncated name ends with `...` instead of `(copy)`. Change duplicate report name creation to correctly append `(copy)` and truncate if necessary without adding ellipsis.

label: bug
file: src/api/reports.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The duplication of report names is handled in the POST /reports/:id/duplicate route in src/api/reports.ts where a copy's name is created by truncating the original name plus " (copy)". The truncation uses the truncate function that appends "..." when cutting at max length. This bug causes the copy's name to end with "..." instead of " (copy)". The fix is to truncate properly without adding ellipsis when adding " (copy)" suffix.

args.title: Preserve non-Latin characters in exported report filenames
args.body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

Modify formatExportFilename to preserve the original letters including non-Latin Greek and Cyrillic characters in export filenames rather than converting everything to ASCII. Currently slugify strips these out, causing exports from such reports to have generic names.

label: bug
file: src/exportUtils.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The export filename creation in src/exportUtils.ts currently uses slugify which lowers ASCII and drops accents, but also strips non-Latin characters entirely. This causes Greek and Cyrillic report names to become empty in the filename. The fix is to preserve Greek and Cyrillic characters so their letters survive in the exported filename.

args.title: Clear upload error message on file selection change
args.body:
File: src/components/UploadForm.tsx

Modify UploadForm component to clear the upload error message as soon as the user selects a new file, instead of waiting for the next upload attempt. This prevents confusion by not showing stale errors after selecting a different file.

label: bug
file: src/components/UploadForm.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The upload error message and its row number are stored in state and cleared only on submit. This causes the old error to remain visible after picking a new file until the user clicks Upload again. The fix is to clear the error state immediately when the selected file changes.
